title: Sparkly sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE066'>
    <path d='M18 22 L20 28 L26 30 L20 32 L18 38 L16 32 L10 30 L16 28 Z'/>
    <path d='M82 18 L83.5 22 L88 23.5 L83.5 25 L82 29 L80.5 25 L76 23.5 L80.5 22 Z'/>
    <path d='M85 62 L86.5 66 L91 67.5 L86.5 69 L85 73 L83.5 69 L79 67.5 L83.5 66 Z'/>
    <path d='M15 70 L16 73 L19 74 L16 75 L15 78 L14 75 L11 74 L14 73 Z'/>
    <path d='M50 10 L51 13 L54 14 L51 15 L50 18 L49 15 L46 14 L49 13 Z'/>
    <path d='M90 42 L91 44.5 L93.5 45.5 L91 46.5 L90 49 L89 46.5 L86.5 45.5 L89 44.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M10 48 L11 50.5 L13.5 51.5 L11 52.5 L10 55 L9 52.5 L6.5 51.5 L9 50.5 Z'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Nori (seaweed) outer ring - deep purple-blue -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='32' fill='#3A3A6E'/>
  <!-- Nori lighter edge -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='32' fill='none' stroke='#5A5A9E' stroke-width='2.5'/>

  <!-- Rice ring - cream -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='24' fill='#FFF5E0'/>
  <!-- Rice texture dots -->
  <g fill='#F0E0C0'>
    <circle cx='34' cy='40' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='34' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='40' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='55' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='68' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='66' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='31' cy='53' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='42' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='44' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='60' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='60' r='1.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Filling center - salmon pink -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='14' fill='#FF8C69'/>
  <!-- Salmon lighter stripe -->
  <path d='M40 48 Q50 42 60 48' stroke='#FFB399' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 56 Q50 62 60 56' stroke='#FFB399' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Cucumber green bit -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='48' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#6BCC6B'/>
  <!-- Avocado light green bit -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='55' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#A8E06B'/>

  <!-- Cute face on rice (not needed but adds cute) -->
  <!-- Actually, let's add tiny cute eyes on the filling -->
  <g fill='#2A1A1A'>
    <circle cx='46' cy='50' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='50' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='46' cy='50' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='50' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Small mouth -->
  <path d='M48 54 Q50 56 52 54' stroke='#2A1A1A' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Chopsticks -->
  <line x1='78' y1='28' x2='92' y2='72' stroke='#C8A060' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='84' y1='26' x2='96' y2='70' stroke='#D8B070' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
